markup:
For powering a refrigerator with a solar generator, I recommend a **portable power station with at least 1,000Wh of battery capacity, 1,500W of AC output, and 200–400W of solar panels**.

For a full-size household refrigerator, a 2,000Wh system is a better choice if you want backup power during overnight outages.

## What size solar generator do you need?

| Refrigerator type | Recommended battery | Estimated runtime without solar |
|---|---|---|
| Mini fridge | 500–1,000Wh | 12–30 hours |
| Energy-efficient full-size fridge | 1,000–2,000Wh | 12–36 hours |
| Standard full-size fridge | 2,000–3,000Wh | 18–48 hours |
| Large side-by-side fridge | 3,000Wh+ | 18–36 hours |

These are rough estimates. Actual runtime depends on the refrigerator's energy consumption, room temperature, and how frequently the compressor runs.
